_about: Made-up scripted Tester replies for DA_LLM_PROVIDER=fake in Approach (spec 11): 9 cases over the 7 criteria of the Excel example. The typed text is ignored.

cases.given: A valid workbook with one visible sheet of three rows
cases.expect: The three rows reach the ingestion flow in order

cases.given: A workbook with two visible sheets
cases.expect: Both sheets are extracted and the sheet names are kept

cases.given: Two visible sheets, one of them blank
cases.expect: The blank sheet is skipped and the other one is extracted

cases.given: One visible sheet and one hidden sheet
cases.expect: Only the visible sheet is extracted
The file is rejected with the standard empty-file error

cases.given: Random bytes saved with an xlsx ending
cases.expect: The file is rejected with the unreadable-file error
The file is rejected with the protected-file error

cases.given: A file type that is not on the allowed list
cases.expect: The existing validator rejects the file

cases.given: A workbook where every visible sheet is empty
cases.expect: The file is rejected with the standard empty-file error

case.given: A workbook where every visible sheet is empty
case.expect: The file is rejected as empty and is not ingested
